summary: Require every current and future first-party EKODI human login and administrator entry to use ekodi.kr/auth and ekodi.kr/admin (or site-owned /{site}/admin), with exact pre-login return and session reuse, as constitutionally inherited forced execution policy.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform owner instructed in this conversation on 2026-10-28: '좋아 에코디랑 협의해서 헌법 및 강제실행규칙으로 설정해', after the all-site search found legacy auth/admin subdomains. Approval authorizes constitutional enforcement and protected source checks, not unverified provider callback or production DNS cutover.
forcedExecution: EKODI Orchestrator is the only change/release coordinator; all agents and sites inherit the policy
only https://ekodi.kr/auth/ is a first-party login browser entry; admin is https://ekodi.kr/admin/ or canonical site-owned path
capture and validate exact trusted initiating page in return_to, preserving functional query and admin child path
reuse valid central sessions without re-login; never use /my as generic post-login fallback
site-scoped server RBAC and CSRF; apex origin alone cannot grant tenant authority
existing zero-subdomain diff guard forbids newly introduced legacy hosts; constitution validator rejects config/policy drift
code review, required CI, protected PR, guarded deployment and independent production canaries before completion
migrationLimitations: Historical login links and AUTH_URL config still require separate remediations and real canaries; declaring policy enforced does not mean they are all migrated.
Legacy OAuth, payment, webhook, CORS/CSP and external provider callbacks may be temporary registered dependencies only, never canonical user entrypoints.
Every host retirement needs per-host C3 evidence, provider callback update, reversible rollback, and separate approval for production DNS/bindings.
Customer-owned domains and mail MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC must be preserved.
preserves: C3 zero-subdomain approval and safeguards from v1.27.2
v1.27.3–v1.27.5 authentication return, session reuse, identity and no-relogin rules
EKODI sovereign authority, site-specific authorization and C3 owner gates
independent service/deployment boundaries under one public origin
rollout: commit constitutional policy+forced guards via official EKODI PR
migrate remaining user-facing auth links and runtime defaults in service-scoped waves
verify Google login and exact return on real mobile/desktop; isolate legacy callbacks and safely retire verified web hosts
rollback: Through approved protected PR, revert only v1.27.6 policy/validator additions while preserving v1.27.2–v1.27.5 security and login continuity. Runtime migrations remain independently reversible; do not blindly restore old public subdomains.
